Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KV Shahdara Vocational Instructor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the KV Shahdara recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Vocational Instructor at PM Shri Kendriya Vidyalaya Shahdara, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Vocational Instructor post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview is 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Vocational Instructor post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is B.E./ B.Tech in Electronic & Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original documents and self-attested copies of ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the KV Shahdara office.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this position?
faq.answer: No, this is a Walk-in recruitment, so online applications are not accepted. You must attend the interview in person.
